senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; אבב)early stage of ripening, esp. of grains; season of beginning barley-crop; also the offering of the first fruits (on Passover).
units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 21a:8">R. Hash. 21ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 16:1">Deut. XVI, 1</cite>) <he>שמור א׳ וכ׳</he> observe the ripening of the equinoctial season that it be in the month of Nissan (rule for intercalation).
